description: This file defines interfaces for grain contracts in an Orleans project, specifically related to implicit subscription counters for testing purposes.

methods.name: GetEventCounter
methods.description: Returns the current event count as a Task<int>.

methods.name: GetErrorCounter
methods.description: Returns the current error count as a Task<int>.

methods.name: DeactivateOnEvent
methods.description: Deactivates the grain based on an event trigger asynchronously.
